verdict.rationale: Factory provides multiple documented mechanisms for autonomous background automation: droid exec for one-shot/CI-CD pipeline runs with tiered autonomy, Missions for multi-agent orchestration of large projects, scheduled/triggered workflows via Software Factory's automation coverage map, and session/API control for driving droid sessions programmatically. These clearly support unattended, background-running automations beyond interactive chat use. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of unattended scheduled runs (e.g., cron-triggered or event-triggered automations firing without any user present), and explicit documentation of failure/retry handling for long-running autonomous jobs.
